cards.name: Bulbasaur

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.effect: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.description: For some time after its birth, it uses the nutrients that are packed into the seed on its back in order to grow.

cards.name: Ivysaur

attacks.name: Leaf Drain
attacks.effect: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.description: The more sunlight Ivysaur bathes in, the more strength wells up within it, allowing the bud on its back to grow larger.

cards.name: Venusaur

abilities.name: Sunny Heal
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may heal 30 damage from your Active Pokémon.

cards.description: While it basks in the sun, it can convert the light into energy. As a result, it is more powerful in the summertime.

cards.name: Exeggcute

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.effect: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.description: If you touch one of Exeggcute’s heads, mistaking it for an egg, the other heads will quickly gather and attack you in a swarm.

attacks.name: Long-Neck Hammering
attacks.effect: 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon is chosen at random. This attack also does 50 damage to it.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.description: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

cards.name: Combee
cards.description: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

cards.name: Vespiquen

attacks.name: Honey Rush
attacks.effect: Reveal all of the Sweet Honey in your hand, and this attack does 50 damage for each card you revealed in this way.

cards.description: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.

cards.name: Deerling
cards.description: These Pokémon are not shy—they will behave as they please, even in front of people. If you feed one of them, it will quickly take a liking to you.

cards.name: Sawsbuck

attacks.name: Leaf Litter Tackle
attacks.effect: Discard a {G} Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.description: There are many Sawsbuck enthusiasts. The darker the red of the foliage that hangs from its antlers, the more stylish the Sawsbuck is thought to be.

cards.name: Foongus
cards.description: There is a theory that the developer of the modern-day Poké Ball really liked Foongus, but this has not been confirmed.

cards.name: Amoonguss

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.effect: Look at a random card from your opponent's hand and shuffle it into their deck.

cards.description: Be wary of the poisonous spores it releases. Mushrooms resembling Amoonguss’s caps will grow out of anywhere the spores touch.

cards.name: Genesect

attacks.name: Signal Beam
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.description: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

cards.name: Cutiefly
cards.description: When it senses the auras of people or Pokémon who are having fun, it will draw close and give them a painful poke with its long proboscis.

cards.name: Ribombee

abilities.name: Honey Gather
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Put a Sweet Honey rental card into your hand.

cards.description: Ribombee can sense when people or Pokémon are feeling down, and it will cheer them up with handmade pollen puffs.

cards.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.effect: Discard a {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.description: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life-force. If Charmander is weak, the flame also burns weakly.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.description: When it swings its burning tail, the temperature around it rises higher and higher, tormenting its opponents.

cards.name: Charizard

abilities.name: Flame Aura
abilities.effect: Whenever you attach a {R} Energy from your Energy Zone to this Pokémon, do 30 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.description: If Charizard becomes truly angered, the flame at the tip of its tail burns in a light blue shade.

cards.name: Volcanion

attacks.name: Dynamite Steam
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 110 damage for each heads.

cards.description: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.description: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.description: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

cards.name: Scorbunny

attacks.name: Rabbit Jumping
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.description: Once its body has heated up, Scorbunny can use the full extent of its power. That’s why it does warm-up exercises.

cards.name: Raboot

abilities.name: Jumping Coach
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in play, flip 3 more coins for the Rabbit Jumping attack used by your Pokémon.

cards.description: Thanks to its soft and fluffy fur, Raboot can easily heat up its fire energy and produce flames with more power.

cards.name: Cinderace

attacks.name: Spinning Kick
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

cards.description: Although Cinderace loses its cool easily, it will battle flawlessly for a Trainer it trusts.

attacks.name: Feisty Flames
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Armarouge

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

cards.description: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

cards.name: Ceruledge

attacks.name: Rally Back
attacks.effect: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.description: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

cards.name: Squirtle

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.description: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It sprays a potent foam from its mouth.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.description: Wartortle’s long, furry tail is a symbol of longevity, so this Pokémon is quite popular among older people.

cards.name: Blastoise

abilities.name: Aqua Charge
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may take a {W} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

cards.description: It deliberately increases its body weight so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

cards.name: Seel
cards.description: The protrusion on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

cards.name: Dewgong

attacks.name: Dual Blizzard
attacks.effect: Discard 2 {W} Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 60 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.description: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it’s colder.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.description: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

cards.name: Cloyster

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.description: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.description: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

cards.name: Lapras

attacks.name: Ice Blade
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.description: It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.

cards.name: Palkia

attacks.name: Spacial Rend
attacks.effect: If your opponent has a Stadium in play, discard it.

cards.description: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.

cards.name: Basculin

attacks.name: Rock Head
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −30 damage from attacks.

cards.description: These Pokémon form schools with others of the same color. The greatest foe of a school of blue Basculin is a school of red Basculin.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.description: Its happy-go-lucky look is an act intended to fool its enemies. It will suddenly drop the facade and overwhelm its foes with its blinding speed.

cards.name: Frogadier

abilities.name: Sudden Duplication
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this card from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Put a random Frogadier from your deck onto your Bench.

cards.description: It excels at devising battle strategies that make use of the terrain, and it never misses its mark when throwing bubble-covered pebbles.

attacks.name: Splash of Darkness
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Thundertail
attacks.effect: Discard 2 {L} Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

cards.name: Electrode

attacks.name: Self-Destruct
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 90 damage to itself.

cards.description: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.description: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.

cards.name: Zeraora

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.description: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

cards.name: Pawmi
cards.description: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

cards.name: Pawmo
cards.description: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

cards.name: Pawmot

abilities.name: Electrocreation
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to the {L} Pokémon in the Active Spot.

cards.description: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

cards.name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Soothing Lullaby
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. Your opponent flips 2 coins for this Special Condition, and if either of them is tails, that Pokémon is still Asleep.

cards.description: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

cards.name: Wigglytuff

attacks.name: Do the Wave
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.description: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

cards.name: Abra
cards.description: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra’s dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.

cards.name: Kadabra
cards.description: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.

cards.name: Alakazam

attacks.name: Mind Jack
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.description: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

attacks.name: Dual Impact
attacks.effect: If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 40 more damage.

attacks.name: Secret Guidance
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. Take an amount of {P} Energy from your Energy Zone equal to the number of heads and attach it to your Benched {P} Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.name: Marill
cards.description: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

cards.name: Azumarill

attacks.name: Rabbit Jumping
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

cards.description: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

cards.name: Espeon

attacks.name: Brainwave
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each {P} Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.description: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent’s next move.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.description: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to pump up its counterstrike.

cards.name: Deoxys

attacks.name: Psycho Boost
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Psycho Boost does −50 damage.

cards.description: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

cards.name: Mimikyu

attacks.name: Dress Up
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.description: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

cards.name: Cosmog

attacks.name: Dust Gathering
attacks.effect: Draw a card.

cards.description: This Pokémon came from another universe. Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentle breeze can blow it away.

cards.name: Cosmoem
cards.description: The absorption of starlight fuels this Pokémon's growth. The shell that encases it is harder than any known material.

cards.name: Lunala

attacks.name: Wings of the Moone
attacks.effect: Move all Energy from this Pokémon to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.description: Known as the Beast That Calls the Moon, this Pokémon lives by taking in any and all light and converting it into its own energy.

cards.name: Diglett

attacks.name: Dig
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

cards.description: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

cards.name: Dugtrio

attacks.name: Triple Smash
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

cards.description: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.description: Rhyhorn claims an area with over a six mile radius as its territory. It apparently forgets where this territory is when running, however.

cards.name: Rhydon

attacks.name: Megahorn
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.description: The horn of a Rhydon is powerful enough to crush raw diamonds. These Pokémon polish their horns by bashing them together.

cards.name: Rhyperior
cards.description: This Pokémon’s sturdy carapace protects it from volcanic eruptions. It shoots round rocks from the holes in its hands.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.description: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

cards.name: Paldean Wooper
cards.description: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

cards.name: Paldean Clodsire

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.description: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It’s a risky move that puts everything on the line.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.description: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

cards.name: Pupitar

attacks.name: Amass
attacks.effect: Take 2 {F} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

cards.description: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

cards.name: Barboach
cards.description: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey’s location.

cards.name: Whiscash

attacks.name: Power Press
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra {F} Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.description: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.description: This Pokémon is very friendly when it’s young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

abilities.name: Reflexive Retaliation
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 30 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

cards.name: Gastly

attacks.name: Severe Gas
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.description: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.description: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

cards.name: Gengar

attacks.name: Twilight Poison
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Asleep.

cards.description: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

cards.name: Umbreon

attacks.name: Moonlit Raid
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, this attack does 50 more damage.

cards.description: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

attacks.name: Crushing Rampage
attacks.effect: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

cards.name: Seviper

attacks.name: Venomous Fang
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.description: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes at unwary prey with venomous fangs.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.description: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

cards.name: Zoroark

attacks.name: Foul Play
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

cards.description: Stories say those who tried to catch Zoroark were trapped in an illusion and punished.

cards.name: Nickit
cards.description: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

cards.name: Thievul
cards.description: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

attacks.name: Shredding Claw
attacks.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 more damage for each heads.

cards.name: Dialga

attacks.name: Roar of Time
attacks.effect: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

cards.description: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.description: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.description: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

cards.name: Solgaleo

attacks.name: Claws of the Sunne
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each point you have gotten.

cards.description: When light radiates from its body, this Pokémon could almost appear to be the sun. It will dispel any darkness and light up the world.

cards.name: Meltan
cards.description: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

cards.name: Melmetal

abilities.name: Metal Scrum
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in play, all of your {M} Pokémon take −20 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon. This effect doesn't stack.

cards.description: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.description: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.description: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

attacks.name: Draconic Meteor
attacks.effect: 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen at random. Do 250 damage to it.

attacks.name: Dragon Impact
attacks.effect: Discard 2 random Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.name: Pidgey

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.effect: Put 1 random {C} Pokémon from your deck into your hand.

cards.description: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

cards.name: Pidgeotto
cards.description: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.

cards.name: Pidgeot

attacks.name: Clean Hit
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.description: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.description: Its reckless nature leads it to stand up to others—even large Pokémon—if it has to protect its territory.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.description: Carrying food through Fearow’s territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

cards.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Signs of Evolution
attacks.effect: Put a random card that evolves from Eevee from your deck into your hand.

cards.description: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

cards.name: Porygon

attacks.name: Powered Ball
attacks.effect: Discard a random Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.description: It is an artificial Pokémon. Since it doesn’t breathe, people are excited by its potential to be useful in any environment.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.description: This artificial Pokémon evolved thanks to cutting-edge science. It sometimes displays behavior that is not in its programming.

cards.name: Porygon-Z

attacks.name: Overdrive Smash
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Overdrive Smash attack does +50 damage.

cards.description: An additional program was installed to create a more advanced Pokémon, but it was apparently flawed. Porygon-Z moves oddly as a result.

cards.name: Snorlax

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.description: This gluttonous Pokémon eats constantly, apart from when it’s asleep. It devours nearly 900 pounds of food per day.

cards.name: Zangoose

abilities.name: Immunity
abilities.effect: This Pokémon can't be affected by any Special Conditions.

cards.description: It’s Seviper’s archenemy. To threaten those it encounters, it fans out the claws on its front paws.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.description: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

cards.name: Bibarel
cards.description: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

cards.name: Buneary

attacks.name: Rabbit Jumping
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.description: If both of Buneary’s ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It’s a sure sign the Pokémon is in need of care.

cards.name: Lopunny

attacks.name: Rabbit Jumping
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

cards.description: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.description: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

attacks.name: Hyper Lariat
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 100 more damage.

cards.name: Sweet Honey
cards.effect: Choose 1 of your Pokémon, and then flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, heal 20 damage from that Pokémon.

cards.name: Super Potion
cards.effect: Heal 40 damage from 1 of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached. If you healed any damage in this way, discard a random Energy from that Pokémon.

cards.name: Max Repel
cards.effect: Switch out your opponent's Active Stage 2 Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

cards.name: Full Heal
cards.effect: Your Active Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.

cards.name: Eviolite
cards.effect: The Basic Pokémon this card is attached to takes −20 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.name: Light Ball
cards.effect: Attacks used by the Pikachu ex this card is attached to do +30 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Lorelei
cards.effect: During this turn, attacks used by your Dewgong, Cloyster, or Lapras do +30 damage to your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.name: Blue's Provocation
cards.effect: You can use this card only if you have Venusaur, Charizard, Blastoise, or Pidgeot in play. Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

cards.name: Serena's Choice
cards.effect: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Shuffle back into your deck.

cards.name: Rika
cards.effect: Produce 2 {F} Energy from your Energy Zone, and attach it to 1 of your Whiscash or Paldean Clodsire.

cards.name: Poké Mart Guy
cards.effect: Put 2 random cards from among Super Potion, Max Repel, and Full Heal from your deck into your hand.

cards.name: Rising Star
cards.effect: You can use this card only if you have 3 or more different Pokémon types in play. Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Abandoned Station
cards.effect: Once during each player's turn, that player may use this effect. Flip a coin. If heads, draw a card.

cards.name: Venusaur

abilities.name: Sunny Heal
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may heal 30 damage from your Active Pokémon.

cards.description: While it basks in the sun, it can convert the light into energy. As a result, it is more powerful in the summertime.

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.effect: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.description: If you touch one of Exeggcute’s heads, mistaking it for an egg, the other heads will quickly gather and attack you in a swarm.

cards.description: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

cards.description: Treecko can quickly scale even vertical surfaces. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.

cards.name: Grovyle

attacks.name: Slicing Snipe
attacks.effect: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Dewgong

cards.description: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it’s colder.

cards.name: Pachirisu

attacks.name: Crackling Snap
attacks.effect: Discard the top card of your deck, and if that card is an Item, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.description: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

cards.name: Abra
cards.description: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra’s dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.

cards.name: Kadabra
cards.description: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.

cards.name: Alakazam

attacks.name: Mind Jack
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.description: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

cards.name: Lunala

cards.description: Known as the Beast That Calls the Moon, this Pokémon lives by taking in any and all light and converting it into its own energy.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.description: Rhyhorn claims an area with over a six mile radius as its territory. It apparently forgets where this territory is when running, however.

cards.name: Rhydon

attacks.name: Megahorn

cards.description: The horn of a Rhydon is powerful enough to crush raw diamonds. These Pokémon polish their horns by bashing them together.

cards.name: Morpeko

cards.name: Solgaleo

cards.name: Spearow

cards.name: Fearow
